verdict.rationale: The evidence pack names a first-party Square "Web Payments SDK" in the developer docs, which points to an embeddable client-side payment component. The pack never describes how it embeds, what it looks like, or how it can be customized. The only other code shown is a server-side payments.create call taking a sourceId, which implies client-side tokenization but does not show it. Missing for 10: documentation of embedding card or payment fields in a merchant's own page or app, evidence of styling and customization options, any contrast with a hosted-redirect checkout, mobile in-app components, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page
